notes: *what meaneth* is read as the interrogative predicate with the verb standing in the copula's slot (rule 20); marking *meaneth* a supplied lexical verb and therefore added is a materially plausible competing reading and is preserved in the unit note.
עַל־מֶה → *Wherefore* heads on the opening morpheme as a pair of particles under rule 23, with the interrogative as the competing source head.
